Wording and negative edits also change length; value changes identity/date and tokenization, not measured truth familiarity. Descriptive train-only lexical counts are not semantic/OOD certification. report_snapshot.contrast_note: Cell codes are identities only and never enter the prompt. Nine contrasts,60 paired rows,10 repeated exposed bases; variable support per comparison(10/6/4). Baseline-to-core changes whole targets, duplication and some incidental propositions, not a pure style contrast. D-to-P preserves question-answer propositions within cores; authored-to-alternate changes the answer value consistently in both targets; negative suffixes follow already exhaustive classifications/sole composer. Positive means no added redundant-negative suffix; scope/exclusivity wording remains explicit.
